dsh-auto-approve 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e3c0c6262f81267ae4c7.html
posts.en:
dsh-auto-approve is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e3c0c6262f81267ae4c7.html
